data.text:
Nakibahagi si Mayor Joy Belmonte sa kick-off ceremony ng Fire Prevention Month ngayong Marso na pinangasiwaan ng Quezon City Fire District (QCFD) sa Risen Garden ng City Hall.

Hinimok ni Mayor Joy ang mga kawani ng QCFD na ipagpatuloy ang kanilang pagiging tapat sa trabaho, maagap na aksyon sa sunog, at pagwaksi ang anumang uri ng kurapsyon sa kanilang hanay.

Kasama sa programa sina City Administrator Mike Alimurung, DILG-QC Director Manny Borromeo, QCFD Marshal FSSupt. Roberto Samillano Jr., QCFD Fire Chief Inspector Marvin Mari, QCPD Director PBGEN. Randy Glenn Silvio, DRRMO head Bianca Perez, at Councilor Egay Yap.

No one — and I mean NO ONE — wants the Philippines Fan Meeting to sell out more than the Filo Westies themselves.

Yes, things behind the scenes have been a bit messy. But through it all, our Westie friends in the Philippines have been working tirelessly — pushing for better fan perks, coordinating grand projects for WilliamEst, and doing everything they can to make this event special for everyone.🩷

And let’s not forget: they’ve already sold 1,200+ tickets, which is huge for WilliamEst’s very first visit to the country.

So let’s rally behind our Filo Westie besties and help hype up the Fan Meeting. Let’s show up the way this fandom always does... loud, proud, and united.

Trust me, it’s going to be kicka$$. Mark my words! ✌🏻

Instead of looking for faults to report...
Let’s send love, encouragement &support🙌🏼

#WilliamEst #วิลเลี่ยมเอส
